body.statement: In the standard special case \(Y(a)=1\) almost surely for every \(a\), one has \(q_x=f_x\), \(G_x=F_x\), and \(\mu(a)=1\); the probability-channel part of \(\mathrm{thm{:}marked\text{-}cocycle\text{-}id}\), with location normalized only by \(E_P[U_2]=0\), reduces to Theorem 1 of Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy.
body.justification: The reduction checks that the marked construction preserves the established unmarked model.
body.gap: This is a compatibility result rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It allows implementations to reuse the existing unmarked analytic-sieve path when the mark carries no information.
